source_title: Cube Partners with Claude to Put Your Governed Financial Model One Question Away - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Finance teams can now find Cube in Claude's connector directory and bring live, permissioned FP&A data into the place they already work with AI.
NEW YORK , Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cube, the agentic FP&A platform, today announced its partnership with Anthropic. Finance teams can now add Cube to Claude through the connector directory and start asking questions, and building new scenarios, across the governed financial model they already trust.
AI is moving into every corner of finance, and the teams getting the most from it are the ones whose answers come from their own data. The Cube connector gives Claude the financial context behind the numbers, including the chart of accounts, business logic, and enterprise permissions. Each team member sees only what they are authorized to access, and figures pulled from Cube can be traced back to the source transaction.
With Cube in Claude, finance teams can ask Claude to:
Compare Actuals vs. Forecast for revenue by entity for the last 12 months
Open the transactions behind an increase in travel spend
Draft a board deck summary of last quarter's financial performance
Set up an upside scenario based on the current forecast
Users add Cube from Claude's connector directory and sign in through a secure OAuth flow, with no API keys to manage. From there, they ask questions in plain English and Claude pulls live figures from Cube, drawing on the same governed model finance already maintains. Each user's Cube permissions carry through to Claude, so the right people see the right data.
"Data tells AI what the numbers are. Financial context tells AI what the numbers mean," said Christina Ross, Founder and CEO of Cube. "This changes how finance works with AI. Finance has spent years building a model it can defend to the board and the auditors, and now that model can be accessed from Claude, where every answer starts from your own data."
The Cube MCP Server is available now in Claude's connector directory at https://claude.ai/directory/cube-software .
Cube is the agentic FP&A platform that helps finance teams shape what happens next. Thousands of finance professionals use Cube to understand what changed, decide what to do, and turn those decisions into action. Learn more at cubesoftware.com.
